Arkham Exchange Updates
April 18, 2025
‍
Dear Arkham User,
We’re pleased to share a number of updates:
1. We’ve streamlined the onboarding process for the Arkham Exchange: passing KYC now takes only
3 minutes
and submitting a proof of address is
no longer required
for the majority of users.
Apply here.
2. Pass KYC and start trading to qualify for
limited time Arkham rewards
: receive a 100 USDT trading fee credit and 10 USDT perps position voucher if you pass KYC. Check your
Rewards Center
to complete the relevant tasks.
3. Season 2 of Arkham Points is ongoing. We distributed over $20 million in rewards in Season 1 and have new tasks for Season 2. Trade on Arkham to receive points &
refer friends
to receive 100 points for each trader referred.
More details on Arkham points here.
With Gratitude,
Arkham Team
